name: The Barn (Stargate Michigan, Saline Township)
summary: Related Digital is building The Barn, a 250-acre campus of three single-story buildings in Saline Township, Michigan, exclusively for Oracle, serving OpenAI under the Oracle-OpenAI Stargate expansion. Announced in October 2025 at more than 1 GW, it is described in later coverage as 1.4 GW. DTE Energy is to supply all power, alongside new battery storage paid for by the project. State regulators approved DTE's contracts for the campus in December 2025. In June 2026 the partners marked construction with all buildings under way and the first nearing completion. Walbridge is general contractor; financing mixes Related Digital and Blackstone-affiliated equity with PIMCO-anchored debt.

location.note: Sources place the site entrance off Michigan Avenue, and news photos show the campus from West Michigan Avenue and from Braun Road on its back side. The point lies on West Michigan Avenue in Saline Township near the line of Braun Road, derived from OpenStreetMap Nominatim road geometry; the county is named in the June 2026 release. It is not a surveyed parcel location.

Planned site construction spending cited by the project team; the overall project is described only as multi-billion-dollar.

Spectrum News reported that an original $4.8 billion cost estimate had risen and the project was now valued at more than $43 billion; the article does not attribute the figure to a named source, and no company source opened here confirms it.
Related Digital also plans to preserve more than 750 adjacent acres as open space, farmland and wetlands.
Union construction jobs; more than 700 Michigan tradespeople were on site in June 2026.
On-site jobs; the developers also project more than 1,500 county-wide jobs.

power_sources.description: DTE Energy is to supply all of the campus's electricity from existing resources under long-term contracts approved by state regulators.
New battery storage financed entirely by the project supplements DTE's supply.
